'''Graham Bingham''' is a ''Star Wars'' CCG player from Atlanta. He finished second at the Dragon Con Mini-Open on 31 August 2008 and received its automatic bid to Day 2 of the [[2008 World Championship]].<ref name="sf-23057-334834">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=334834#p334834 SWCCG DragonCon Cube Booster Draft Report & Pictures!], Throdo (Jonathan Murray), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (9 September 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125194827/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t23057.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="sf-22883-332133">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=332133#p332133 List of People who have Worlds Day Two Auto Bids 2008], simone89, Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (29 August 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125194535/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t22883.html Internet Archive]</ref>
